title: Rust multi-crate analytics workspace
spec: Build a stable-Rust workspace with crates for domain types, streaming parsing, parallel aggregation, a CLI, and a small HTTP-free report renderer. Generate 600,000 deterministic line-delimited records in 12 shards. Include malformed-input handling, deterministic parallel results, unit/integration tests, Criterion-free timing, and a release build.
prompts: Create the Cargo workspace, domain crate, streaming parser, CLI contract, and focused tests.
Implement deterministic 600,000-record generation and bounded-memory parsing across 12 shards.
Add bounded parallel aggregation with stable output and tests proving agreement with sequential aggregation.
Add schema migration and corruption recovery, plus an HTML report renderer and integration tests.
Run fmt check, clippy, locked workspace tests, measured analytics run, and locked release build. Fix failures and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
